title: Antala Industries IPO Details
intro:
Antala Industries IPO is a book build issue of ₹23.33 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 34.82 lakh shares of ₹23.33 crore.

Antala Industries IPO opens for subscription on Oct 29, 2026 and closes on Nov 2, 2026. The allotment for the Antala Industries IPO is expected to be finalized on Nov 3, 2026. Antala Industries IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Nov 5, 2026.

Antala Industries IPO is set issue price band at ₹63 to ₹67 per share. The lot size for an application is 2,000 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,68,000 (4,000 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (6,000 shares), amounting to ₹4,02,000.

Vatsa Capital Venture Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Asnani Stock Broker Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Antala Industries IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in August 2024, Antala Industries Limited is engaged in the manufacturing, processing, printing, laminating and supply of industrial and commercial packaging products. The Company specializes in BOPP bags, BOPP printing rolls, BOPP lamination rolls, PP woven bags and PP woven lamination rolls, serving customers across industries such as food processing, fertilizers, chemicals, cement and seeds. The Company operates an integrated manufacturing facility in Rajkot, Gujarat, with capabilities including extrusion, coating and lamination, rotogravure printing, stitching and finishing.

The Company provides customized packaging solutions focused on strength, durability, moisture resistance, high-quality printability and enhanced product visibility. Its integrated manufacturing setup enables in-house processing from printing and lamination to cutting, stitching, finishing and packaging, supporting quality control, production efficiency and timely delivery. The Company holds ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 22000:2018 and ISO 45001:2018 certifications and is backed by promoters with nearly three decades of experience in the packaging industry.

As of September 30, 2026, the Company had 11 employees across accounts and finance, management, administration, sales, secretarial and production functions. Its key strengths include experienced promoters and management, a diversified and customizable product portfolio, presence across multiple end-user industries, customer-focused manufacturing and delivery capabilities, and established supplier and customer relationships.
strengths: Experienced promoters and management team with extensive packaging industry expertise.
Diversified product portfolio with customization capabilities.
Integrated manufacturing capabilities supporting operational efficiency.

faqs.question: How to apply in Antala Industries IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Antala Industries IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Antala Industries IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Antala Industries IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Antala Industries IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.
